name: F‑4 Phantom II
physical_description: Twin‑engine, tandem two‑seat, large fuselage with distinctive wing kink.
purpose_features: Designed as long‑range interceptor & fighter‑bomber; served extensively in Vietnam and allied air forces.

name: A‑10 Thunderbolt II
physical_description: Straight, wide wings; twin turbofans; massive GAU‑8 Avenger cannon in nose.
purpose_features: Close air support aircraft designed to destroy tanks & ground targets; rugged and survivable.

name: F‑22 Raptor
physical_description: Twin‑engine stealth fighter with angular edges and thrust vectoring nozzles.
purpose_features: Air superiority 5th‑gen stealth fighter; unmatched in maneuverability and sensor fusion.

name: F‑35B Lightning II
physical_description: Stealth single‑engine fighter with internal weapons bays.
purpose_features: Multirole 5th‑gen; B variant has short takeoff/vertical landing for Marines.

name: F‑35C Lightning II
physical_description: Carrier variant with larger wings and reinforced gear.
purpose_features: Designed for U.S. Navy carriers; long range and payload for strike missions.

name: YF‑23 Black Widow II
physical_description: Stealth prototype with diamond wings and twin canted tails.
purpose_features: Advanced stealth fighter prototype; lost to F‑22 in ATF competition.

name: F‑15 Eagle
physical_description: Twin‑engine, large air intakes, twin vertical tails.
purpose_features: Air superiority fighter dominating skies in multiple conflicts.

name: F‑16 Fighting Falcon
physical_description: Single‑engine agile fighter with bubble canopy and blended wing body.
purpose_features: Multirole fighter used worldwide; emphasis on agility and affordability.

name: F‑18 Hornet
physical_description: Twin‑engine, carrier‑capable fighter with leading‑edge extensions.
purpose_features: Carrier multirole for U.S. Navy and Marines; strong strike and air skills.

name: F‑18 Super Hornet
physical_description: Larger, updated Hornet with more payload and range.
purpose_features: Frontline U.S. Navy strike fighter replacing older Hornets.

name: F‑14 Tomcat
physical_description: Variable‑sweep wings, twin tails, large intakes.
purpose_features: Carrier interceptor famous from Cold War and popular culture.

name: F‑117 Nighthawk
physical_description: Faceted stealth design with distinctive angular surfaces.
purpose_features: Stealth attack aircraft; changed modern warfare with low‑observable tech.

name: F‑105 Thunderchief
physical_description: Large single‑engine fighter‑bomber with swept wings.
purpose_features: Primary strike aircraft early in Vietnam; notable payload and speed.

name: MiG‑15
physical_description: Straight wing, nose intake, single‑engine early jet.
purpose_features: First successful swept‑wing Soviet jet; dominated Korean War dogfights.

name: MiG‑17
physical_description: Refined swept‑wing design with improved performance over MiG‑15.
purpose_features: Used widely in Cold War conflicts; robust and simple fighter.

name: MiG‑19
physical_description: Twin‑engine supersonic fighter with mid‑wing and traditional tail.
purpose_features: First Soviet supersonic fighter in level flight; interceptor role.

name: MiG‑21
physical_description: Delta wing, nose intake, classic compact supersonic design.
purpose_features: Iconic Cold War fighter; widely exported and used in many conflicts.

name: MiG‑23
physical_description: Variable‑geometry wings and large fuselage.
purpose_features: Swing‑wing interceptor/fighter; improved radar and weapons over earlier jets.

name: MiG‑25 Foxbat
physical_description: Huge twin‑engine high‑altitude interceptor with thin wings.
purpose_features: Designed to intercept high‑speed threats; one of fastest military jets.

name: MiG‑29
physical_description: Twin tail, twin engine, high thrust‑to‑weight maneuverable airframe.
purpose_features: 4th‑gen air superiority fighter with excellent dogfight performance.

name: MiG‑31 Foxhound
physical_description: Large interceptor with long fuselage and powerful radar.
purpose_features: High‑speed interceptor designed to chase bombers and cruise missiles.

name: Su‑7
physical_description: Single‑engine fighter‑bomber with swept wings.
purpose_features: Ground‑attack aircraft with good acceleration and payload.

name: Su‑17 / Su‑20 / Su‑22
physical_description: Variable‑geometry wing fighter‑bomber family.
purpose_features: Multirole attack aircraft used widely by Warsaw Pact forces.

name: Su‑24 Fencer
physical_description: Twin‑engine swing‑wing all‑weather bomber.
purpose_features: Tactical bomber/interdictor for deep strikes with terrain‑following radar.

name: Su‑25 Frogfoot
physical_description: Rugged twin‑tail close‑air support jet with armored cockpit.
purpose_features: Frontline CAS aircraft akin to A‑10; built to take damage and stay flying.

name: Su‑27 Flanker
physical_description: Large twin‑engine fighter with blended wing/body and twin tails.
purpose_features: 4th‑gen air superiority fighter, excellent range and agility.

name: Su‑30
physical_description: Two‑seat Flanker variant with enhanced avionics.
purpose_features: Multirole air superiority & strike fighter widely exported.

name: Su‑35
physical_description: Advanced Flanker with thrust vectoring and upgraded sensors.
purpose_features: 4++ generation multirole fighter with strong situational awareness.

name: Chengdu J‑20
physical_description: Stealth twin‑engine 5th‑gen fighter with chinesed foreplanes and internal bays.
purpose_features: Air superiority & strike; China’s first operational 5th‑gen aircraft with low observables.

name: Chengdu J‑10
physical_description: Single‑engine lightweight multirole fighter with cropped delta wing and strake.
purpose_features: Primary Chinese multirole fighter; versatile air‑to‑air and ground attack capability.

name: Shenyang J‑11
physical_description: Twin‑engine air superiority fighter based on Su‑27 design with Chinese avionics.
purpose_features: Heavy fighter for air dominance; evolved into modern derivatives with better systems.

name: Shenyang J‑15
physical_description: Carrier‑based twin‑engine fighter with foldable wings and canards.
purpose_features: China’s carrier fighter; combines heavy payload with naval operations capability.

name: Chengdu J‑16
physical_description: Two‑seat multirole strike fighter derived from J‑11 with advanced avionics.
purpose_features: Strike/air superiority with modern sensors and weapons; key PLA‑AF tactical asset.

name: BAE Hawk 200
physical_description: Single‑engine lightweight jet with sleek fuselage and small wings, designed for agility.
purpose_features: Advanced trainer and light attack aircraft; exported to several countries for combat and training.

name: Harrier GR.1 / GR.3
physical_description: V/STOL aircraft with vectored‑thrust nozzles and compact fuselage for vertical operations.
purpose_features: Ground‑attack, close air support, and carrier operations; iconic for Falklands War.

name: Harrier GR.5 / GR.7 / GR.9
physical_description: Upgraded V/STOL attack aircraft with modern avionics and improved engine thrust.
purpose_features: Continued Harrier operations with better precision strike and reconnaissance capabilities.

name: SEPECAT Jaguar
physical_description: Twin‑seat, twin‑engine strike aircraft with swept wings and robust fuselage.
purpose_features: Ground‑attack, reconnaissance, and nuclear strike roles; operated by RAF and export customers.

name: Dassault Mirage III
physical_description: Delta wing, single‑engine fighter with sleek fuselage and pointed nose.
purpose_features: Interceptor and multirole fighter; widely exported, iconic in Cold War era.

name: Dassault Mirage 5/50
physical_description: Delta wing fighter-bomber, derived from Mirage III, optimized for ground attack.
purpose_features: Ground-attack variant; exported widely to Middle East and Latin America.

name: Dassault Mirage F1
physical_description: High-mounted swept wing, single-engine, conventional tail design.
purpose_features: Multirole fighter; served as interceptor and tactical ground attack aircraft.

name: Dassault Mirage 2000
physical_description: Single-engine delta wing fighter with modern avionics and refined aerodynamics.
purpose_features: Air superiority and multirole fighter; upgraded over time with advanced missiles and electronics.

name: Super Étendard
physical_description: Carrier-capable single-engine attack aircraft with swept wings and low fuselage.
purpose_features: Naval strike aircraft; famous for Exocet missile attacks in Falklands War.

name: AMX International AMX
physical_description: Single-engine, light strike aircraft with high wing and conventional tail.
purpose_features: Ground-attack and reconnaissance; operated by Italian and Brazilian air forces as well.

name: MB.326GB
physical_description: Small, single-engine jet trainer with low wings and tandem cockpit.
purpose_features: Trainer and light attack aircraft; used to train generations of military pilots.

name: AMX International AMX
physical_description: Single-engine, light strike aircraft with high wing and conventional tail.
purpose_features: Ground-attack and reconnaissance; served in Italian Air Force and export countries.

name: Panavia Tornado
physical_description: Twin-engine variable-geometry wing multirole fighter-bomber.
purpose_features: Strike, reconnaissance, and electronic warfare roles; operated by multiple NATO countries including Italy.

name: IAI Kfir C.1
physical_description: Delta wing single-engine fighter based on Mirage 5 with Israeli avionics and improvements.
purpose_features: Multirole fighter for air superiority and ground attack; exported to several countries.

name: IAI Kfir C.2 / C.7
physical_description: Upgraded Kfir variants with better avionics, engines, and multirole capability.
purpose_features: Export and improved operational versions for Israel; capable in strike and interception roles.
